Oneliner

demonstrate three world-first technologies in Low Earth Orbit (LEO).
Description

Our mission aims to demonstrate three world-first technologies in Low Earth Orbit (LEO):

  • The first-ever real-time kinematic (RTK)-based relative navigation in LEO.
  • The first-ever propellant-free autonomous rendezvous and formation flying using aerodynamic forces.
  • The first-ever real-time CubeSat GPS-only attitude determination system.
Results
  • All 12 Nuri-deployed cube satellites establish ground communication, 2025-12-08.
  • [2025.12.15] SNUGLITE-III Two-way Communication Success
